posts.subject: Unicorn's bans
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello,


I am not glad that I have to write this and I have nothing against @Unicorn24 but after browsing source bans I have noticed that his bans are for abnormal amounts of time. For example 2 month ban for= "RDM and leaving server" or 6 months for racism and offensivity (it is bad but 6 motnhs?).


So the reason I am doing this is to openly ask if this is correct. As I said before nothing against you but for me those amounts seems unfair to players. If higher admins will prove you are doing fine, I will rise my punishments as well but for now I think this is too much. I am doing it for players and good name of our community.


Thanks and don't get mad on me 🙂

I think it depends on what they did. im quite sure with this 2mo ban he missclicked and wanted to select 2wk. Robins old ban had just expired when he came on the server and did the same thing again.


But i cant say anything about the racism bans

Maybe next time you will contact me before posting a thread about this. The 2 Months Ban is false, I misscklicked, schould be a 1 Month ban.


And the 2 bans with each 6months are because, there were 2 Friends that joined the Server, singing "Heil Hitler","Sieg Heil" "Fuck you all" , while voicespamming and randommkilling the hole server. I littleraly warned them and said to stop that, then they insulted me and i banned them.


And im banning people for a long time, but you can ask everyone, im warning players many times! Im kicking and warning people before baning them.


Maybe we can talk later on TS together.

As I said I had no meaning against you and I did thread instead talk to you to see responds of "all" admins so I can see their opinions and then I can maybe adjust my bans. It is more like discusion about ban lenghts.
